servesPizza.name: Stoneburner
servesPizza.note: An Italian restaurant and bar on the ground floor of Hotel Ballard whose menu centers on housemade pasta and vegetable dishes, with a rotating seasonal wood-fired pizza (e.g. winter squash, basil, and imported white cheese) alongside it.

servesPizza.name: Petoskey's
servesPizza.note: A Fremont neighborhood sports bar with an Upper Midwest-leaning menu of hoagies, cheese curds, and beer that also serves a thin-crust "Midwest Tavern Style" pizza, available whole or by the slice.
